title: paged-kv-cache-block-manager-priority-pinning-reuse-optimizations
author: Sofia Patel
description: Improve paged KV cache block manager: introduce allocator reuse across allocations, priority/locality-aware pinning heuristic, and adaptive TTL to reduce churn under continuous batching. Motivation: under high-concurrency continuous batching workloads we observed elevated eviction churn and lock contention in the block allocator which increased p99 latency and reduced throughput. This PR reduces allocator churn by reusing recently freed blocks where safe, pins hot blocks using a locality + priority score to avoid unnecessary evictions, and adds an adaptive TTL for cold blocks to avoid thrashing when request patterns fluctuate. Changes include lock contention reduction (split hot/cold lists), stronger invariants and assertions, additional metrics (pin_count, reuse_hits, eviction_retries), and a suite of unit + integration tests and microbenchmarks. The description below includes high level commits, files changed, review thread, CI history, and benchmark results.

review_comments: Ethan Li (request changes): observed a rare race in try_reuse_block under heavy GC; suggested adding stronger debug assertions and a fast-path that falls back to fresh allocation when state is uncertain.
Sofia Patel (author): added assertions and a conservative fallback on next push (commit 3). Also added a targeted unit test that reproduces the race locally (tests/kv_cache/allocator_race.rs).
Maya Gonzalez (comment): asked for metrics to help tune TTL and pin heuristic in staging. Requested adding reuse_hits and eviction_retries counters to the block manager metrics.
Sofia Patel (author): exposed reuse_hits, eviction_retries, and pin_count via metrics.rs and added a dashboard prototype in docs.
Jasper Nguyen (approve): Verified with bench harness that p99 improved and concurrency stalls reduced; approved after CI green and small nits addressed.
ci_checks: ci/unit-tests — flaky failure on allocator_race.rs (detected, fixed in follow-up commit), rerun passed
benchmarks: Continuous batching microbench (64 concurrent streams): throughput +20% (steady-state), p99 latency -12% on average across two models (gpt-medium-like, llama2-13b-like).
Eviction churn reduction: reuse_hits observed ~32% of allocations in steady-state workload, eviction_retries dropped from 4.5% to 0.9%.
Lock contention: average global allocator lock hold time decreased ~60% in microbench traces; end-to-end tail latency improvements visible under high concurrency.
release_notes: Paged KV cache: allocator reuse pool to reduce allocation churn and improve throughput under continuous batching.
Priority/locality-aware pinning to reduce evictions of hot KV blocks and improve p99 latency.
Adaptive TTL policy to reduce thrash when request locality shifts; new tuning knobs exposed in dev docs.
